QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] I Need a Sample of the Cells
QuestInfo.0: The Black Wing mad scientist #b#p2154009##k in #m310060000# in the Mine is obsessed with experimenting.
QuestInfo.1: #p2154009# says he's so curious about the Rue creation mechanism of the #r#o8105005##k that he simply cannot stand it anymore. He wants you to find him a #b#t4032776##k. He doesn't seem like he's in his right mind... \r\n\r\n#i4032776# #t4032776# #b#c4032776# / 30
QuestInfo.2: #p2154009# laughs with happiness and excitement. With this DNA Sample, cloning an Ore Muncher may be possible... You see now that #p2154009# really isn't in his right mind.

0.msg: I'm so curious, I'm going crazy! What is the mechanism behind the #o8105005#? How does it create Rue ores by eating rocks and boulders? I can't stand not knowing the principal behind it! \r\n

1.msg: #b(#p2154009# is talking like a lunatic. Makes you nervous to approach him...)

2.msg: There must be way to find out. Ah, yes, there is one way. And you will help me with it! Of course you will! Why wouldn't you want to be a part of this research that will be known as mankind's legacy?!

yes.0: I need you to go get #b30 Cell Samples#k from the #r#o8105005#s#k. It won't be easy, since these strange creatures have hard skin, and are destroyed easily when their HP gets low. But I have faith in you!
yes.1: Something amazing will be discovered. Yes, it will! *mumble*... *mumble*...

no.0: Refuse? How dare you? You are the evil being preventing the development of science! I will destroy you in the name of science!

1.0: *mumble*... *mumble*... If that is the case, than the 41st hypothesis would suggest that the mechanism behind the Ore Munchers is not chemical but... Finally! Have you brought the #t4032776# items?

yes.0: Muhahah! Yes! This is it! With this, cloning Ore Munchers is no longer a dream! I will be known as the greatest scientist in the history of the world! Muahahaha!

item.0: Have you still not brought back #b30 #t4032776#s#k? Science will not wait for you forever! Science is impatient! Science is getting angry! You wouldn't like science when it's angry!
